title: Tableau Cloud Bulk Export and Download Audit
dataSources: Tableau Cloud Activity Log (`tableau:cloud:activity`) and Admin Insights.
app: Tableau Cloud Activity Log and Admin Insights exports plus the Tableau Cloud REST API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:cloud:activity (action="download_workbook" OR action="download_view")
| stats count as exports, sum(coalesce(row_count,rows,record_count)) as rows by user
| eventstats avg(rows) as avg_rows, stdev(rows) as sd_rows
| where rows>avg_rows+3*sd_rows
| sort - rows
description: Watches Tableau Cloud for users exporting or downloading unusually large volumes of data, a signal for both data-exfiltration risk and ungoverned spreadsheet sprawl.
value: Large exports move governed data out of Tableau Cloud where it can no longer be controlled; anomaly detection flags the risky ones for review.
implementation: Ingest Tableau Cloud export/download events with row counts; schedule daily and alert on 3-sigma export-volume anomalies per user.
visualization: Table of user by export volume, anomaly markers.
grandmaExplanation: We notice when someone pulls an unusually large amount of data out of Tableau Cloud so it can be checked.
